## About
Perez Logistics Inc. is a family owned logistics provider based in Houston, Texas. Our job is simple to say and hard to do well: get your shipment to its destination as safely and quickly as possible while giving you real value for what you spend.
Customers have given us a 4.9 rating across 22 Google reviews. One reviewer used our service for containers from Houston Port to Dallas and said the price was fair and the job got done. If you have a shipment coming up, give us a call and we'll talk it through.

## Services
- Getting your shipment to its destination: Logistics focused on getting your shipment to its destination as safely and quickly as possible, at a good value.
- Containers from Houston Port: One customer used our service for containers from Houston Port to Dallas and called the price fair.

## FAQ
Q: Do you handle containers from Houston Port?
A: Yes. One customer used our service for containers from Houston Port to Dallas.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're closed Saturday and Sunday, so reach out to us during the week.
